rigidAxioms: Rust rule closure: Zero raw unwrap/expect/panic!/unreachable!; all errors propagate via thiserror (FGT-*, RSM-*).
Type-state architecture: Sealed traits, compile-time type-state machines, #[repr(transparent)] newtypes, #[must_use].
Zero transient heap allocation: Ban &String/&Vec<T> params (RSM-STR-001); epoch pool reuse; ban gratuitous .clone() (RSM-CLONE-001).
Guard clauses & flat control flow: Use let-else (RSM-ELSE-001) for CC <= 15 and Depth <= 4; TryFrom for casts (RSM-CAST-001).
Lock-free concurrency: CAS epoch lock-free primitives for indexing/staging; zero Mutex/RwLock on hot paths (FGT-LCK-001 / FGT-CAS-001).
Strict unsafe audit: Every unsafe block requires adjacent // SAFETY: proof; unsafe surface strictly non-increasing (FGT-SAF-001).
Kernel-facade parity: Rust kernel & TS facade 100% byte equivalent (FGT-ALG-001); constants in fg-core::constants; zero Clippy warnings.
